producers.name: Saltrock Dairy Farm
producers.description: A 70-acre coastal farm on Tara Hill in North Wexford. Catherine and Paul Kinsella produce non-homogenised pasteurised milk, farmhouse butter, yoghurt and kefir from grass-fed Holstein Cross cows, sold direct in reusable glass bottles from their self-service farm unit.

producers.name: Ballyowen Farm
producers.description: Ballyowen Farm produces seasonal vegetables and fruit from its holding near Wellington Bridge, selling through local farm shops and markets in the area.

producers.name: GIY
producers.description: GIY (Grow It Yourself) is a social enterprise based at GROW HQ in Waterford city, running a certified organic farm and kitchen garden at the Curraghmore Estate. Known for its weekly organic veg box and for building a movement of home growers across Ireland.

producers.name: Green Earth Organics
producers.description: A certified organic farm near Corrandulla, run by Kenneth and Jenny Keavey since 2006. Grows a wide range of organic vegetables across field crops and six polytunnels, supplying produce through a weekly box scheme.

producers.name: Mill House Farm
producers.description: A certified organic salad and mixed leaf grower in Williamstown, run by Audrey Hession and Mick Wright since 2009. Specialises in year-round organic salad crops including mixed leaves, rocket, spinach, and butterhead lettuce.

producers.name: An Garraí Glas
producers.description: A 1-acre chemical-free vegetable garden in Na Creagain, Inverin, in south Connemara. Grows lettuce, onions, tomatoes, herbs, and salad leaves using on-farm compost made from seaweed and local food waste.

producers.name: Muff Honey
producers.description: We are a small honey producer with over 20 hives here in Muff, Kingscourt co Cavan. We sell our honey from the honesty box outside our home Apiary.

producers.name: Coppenagh House Farm
producers.description: A family farm and farm shop on the outskirts of Tullow, rearing Wagyu-cross beef cattle, pigs, and keeping bees. Produces home-reared beef, pork, bacon, and honey, sold direct through its shop and nationwide delivery.

producers.name: Skehana Hill
producers.product: Organic Vegetables, Lamb, Beef and Pork
producers.description: Skehana Hill Farm is an organic mixed farm who's focus is on farming in tune with nature in order to produce food which which nurtures human health, community and biodiversity.

producers.name: SeanNua Farm
producers.product: Chemical Free Market Garden, Pasture-Raised Eggs & Meat Chickens, Grass Fed & Finished Beef, Pasture & Forest Raised Pork
producers.description: A chemical-free farm near Bailieborough, producing pasture-raised eggs, market garden vegetables, grass-fed and finished beef, and pork from pigs raised on pasture and in woodland. All produce is sold direct from farm to consumer.

producers.name: Forest Hill Farm
producers.description: A chemical-free farm in Bailieborough, where slow-grown lamb grazes on fresh grass, herbs, and wildflowers, and rare-breed pigs forage freely in farm woodland. No chemical sprays or fertilisers are used on the land.

producers.name: Carraig Abhainn Farm
producers.description: Carraig Abhainn Farm raises free-range pigs, selling pork direct to customers.

producers.name: Giron's Farm
producers.product: Seasonal Vegetables, Herbs, Microgreens & Edible Flowers
producers.description: Giron's Farm grows seasonal vegetables, herbs, microgreens, and edible flowers, supplying restaurants and local customers.

producers.name: Wolf Seeds
producers.description: A family run organic seed farm growing vegetables which we hand save seeds from. At our old cottage we grow various garden vegetables (heirlooms, landraces, interesting open pollinated varieties etc.) and adopt the populations to the local climate. The best seed bank is a living garden...

producers.name: Lunasa Farm
producers.description: A certified organic family farm raising heritage breed pigs outdoors year-round on a certified organic ration. Beef cattle are managed using holistic planned grazing and are 100% pasture-fed and finished.

producers.name: The Rock Ballymacavany
producers.product: Tallow Balm & Open Pollinated Seed Bank
producers.description: A smallholding in the hills producing tallow balm from Irish tallow and botanicals sourced from named local farms. Also maintains an open-pollinated seed bank of regionally adapted heirloom varieties focused on biodiversity and seed sovereignty.

producers.name: New Leaf Urban Farmers
producers.description: A 1.5-acre market garden in Ballyneety, believed to be the first commercial-scale application of Korean Natural Farming methods in Ireland. No herbicides, pesticides, or machinery are used; all inputs are made on-farm or from the surrounding hills.

producers.name: Rigney's Farm (Curraghchase Free Range Pork)
producers.description: A family farm near Kilcornan, raising rare-breed Tamworth and Saddleback pigs and Shorthorn beef cattle. The pigs are free-range, the beef is 100% grass-fed, and the farm is known for its dry-cured bacon, ham, sausages, and puddings.

producers.name: Graze Dairy
producers.description: Graze Dairy produces fresh milk from grass-fed cows on pasture in Co. Kildare, selling direct to local customers.

producers.name: Duhallow Organics
producers.description: Duhallow Organics raises native Dexter cattle and hens on certified organic land in Co. Cork, producing grass-fed beef and free-range eggs for direct local sale.

producers.name: Moy Hill Farm
producers.description: Moy Hill Farm grows seasonal garden vegetables and raises pasture-fed beef and free-range eggs on the Atlantic coast of Co. Clare, selling through local markets and direct from the farm.

producers.name: Mad Yolk Farm
producers.description: Mad Yolk Farm raises hens on open pasture alongside a chemical-free seasonal vegetable plot. Eggs from hens that actually roam, and veg grown without sprays. Both sold directly from the farm.

producers.name: Beechlawn Organic Farm
producers.description: A certified organic vegetable farm near Ballinasloe, run by Pat and Sinéad Clarke. Grows a wide range of seasonal vegetables and salads for farmers markets, veg box delivery, and local retailers across Connacht.

producers.name: Gleann Bui Farm
producers.description: Gleann Bui Farm produces organic raw dairy on the plains of Co. Mayo. One of a small number of Irish farms offering raw milk direct to the consumer: unheated, unprocessed, exactly as it comes from the cow.

producers.name: Finlay's Dairy Farm
producers.description: Founded by Micheál and Cora, Moo Cow sells fresh milk from their own grass-fed cows, gently pasteurised on site and dispensed through self-service vending machines in reusable glass bottles. Farm to bottle, no middleman.

producers.name: Walsh's Organic Eggs
producers.description: We are an organic certified farm with cattle and hens. We are a family run business set in the hills in Cappamore. We deliver or meet customers with our eggs and can guarantee freshness, taste and organicness(is that a word).

producers.name: Fiorbhia Farm
producers.description: A 100% biological agroforestry farm near Portlaoise, described as the only farm of its kind in Ireland. Pigs, beef cattle, and poultry are reared through trees in a chemical-free, closed-loop forest system with no antibiotics or growth hormones, and all produce is sold direct.

producers.name: Regan Organic Farm
producers.description: A 45-acre certified organic farm near Enniscorthy, registered organic since 2006. Produces organic table chickens reared to 12 weeks on organic meal in an active outdoor environment, processed in an on-farm EU-approved facility.

producers.name: Rathgarogue Organic Farm
producers.description: Pasture raised hens roaming freely all day, eating grass and herbs.

producers.name: Wexford Sea Salt
producers.description: Harvested from the Irish Sea along the Wexford coast. Sun dried. Nothing added.

producers.name: The Apple Farm
producers.description: The Apple Farm near Cahir, has been growing fruit since 1968 across orchards planted by the Traas family, who brought their growers' heritage from the Netherlands. Produces 60 varieties of apples alongside soft fruit, and is known for its apple juices, cider vinegar, and sparkling apple juice made on-site.

producers.name: Newbard Organic Farm Ltd
producers.description: We are Siobhán and Ross. Since 2012 we have raised heritage breed pigs, lamb and chicken on certified organic pasture near Lismore. We farm on the principle that the soil, the animal and the person eating it are all part of the same system, and that each one deserves to be treated as such.

producers.name: Fat Tomato
producers.description: An edible garden on Carrig Rua Hill, growing over 500 heritage and open-pollinated varieties of vegetables, fruit, herbs, and edible flowers chosen for flavour. Founded by chef Anthony O'Toole, the garden runs a year-round honesty farm shop and produces small-batch condiments, pickles, and ferments.

producers.name: Glenbrook Farm
producers.description: A free-range pig farm near White's Cross, run by Peter Twomey on family land, established after transitioning from dairy farming. The pigs are born outdoors, rotationally grazed across paddocks to root and forage, with pork sold at the English Market in Cork.

producers.name: O'Callaghan Family Farm
producers.description: O'Callaghan Family Farm produces beef, selling direct to customers.

producers.name: Wexford Organics
producers.description: Wexford Organics produces seasonal Irish vegetables, growing and supplying produce to local customers.

producers.name: Garden County Organics
producers.description: A certified organic farm of four acres near Kilmacurragh, in operation since 2012. Run by Dan Whelehan, growing seasonal organic salad leaves, mixed leaves, soft fruit, and vegetables for local restaurants and markets.

producers.name: Castleruddery Organic Farm
producers.description: One of the longest-established certified organic farms in Ireland, growing vegetables and herbs in the foothills of the Wicklow Mountains since 1989. Run by Dominic and Hilda Crampton using natural soil enrichment with no synthetic fertiliser, with portions of the land rewilded.

producers.name: Keadeen Mountain Farms
producers.description: Raises Ireland's largest pedigree Dexter herd across 400 acres of mountain pasture at the foothills of Keadeen Mountain near Kiltegan. Certified organic by Organic Trust. All beef is dry-aged for 17 days before sale direct from the farm.

producers.name: Windmill Honey
producers.description: A family-run beekeeping operation in Cashel, established in 2020 and rooted in four generations of family beekeeping knowledge. Produces 100% raw honey from hives kept among the Golden Vale pastures using traditional sustainable practices.

producers.name: Tara Hill Honey
producers.description: Produced on the eastern slopes of Tara Hill on the Wexford coast, with bees foraging within a 3-mile radius on blackberry, clover, chestnut, and local wildflowers. The honey is unpasteurised and coarse-filtered with pollen retained, brought to jar in a raw state.

producers.name: Killiane Castle Honey
producers.description: Produced by Ian Mernagh from beehives on the grounds of Killiane Castle estate near Wexford town, started in 2015 with two hives using locally bred Irish native bees. Produces raw unfiltered honey and creamed honey.

producers.name: Moyletra Moileds
producers.description: We are David and Sandra, a fifth-generation farming family on the Causeway Coast of Northern Ireland, raising pedigree Irish Moiled cattle. Our cattle are slow-grown on pasture using low-input farming, producing exceptional native beef while safeguarding one of Ireland's rarest breeds for future generations.

producers.name: iDevour
producers.description: A family-run grass-fed beef operation based in Larne, farming across four generations. Cattle are slow-grown on Irish pasture with an emphasis on welfare-centred husbandry, and beef is sold direct nationwide.

producers.name: Spear & Arrow
producers.description: We are a micro food production business making Irish grass fed beef bone broth using only natural ingredients with full traceability from farm to cup.

producers.name: Dungarvan Honey
producers.description: A family-run beekeeping business in Dungarvan, founded by the Reilly family in 2020. Hives are moved seasonally to follow different blooms — blackberry, lime, chestnut, and clover — and the honey is 100% raw Irish blossom honey.

producers.name: White Grass Farm
producers.description: White Grass Farm produces beef, selling direct to customers.

producers.name: Carncash Farm
producers.description: Carncash Farm raises Dexter cattle, selling beef direct in boxes. Dexter is a small, hardy native Irish breed known for well-marbled beef well suited to Irish grazing conditions.

producers.name: Chestnutt's Farm
producers.description: A fourth-generation family dairy farm outside Portrush, farming since 1913. Produces farm-fresh milk gently pasteurised, non-homogenised, and non-standardised, and is known for its strained Greek-style yoghurt made using only their own milk and live culture.

producers.name: The Milk Well
producers.description: The Milk Well sells Farm Fresh Milk through their self-service vending machines. The milk is pasteurised but not homogenised, resulting in a delicious creamy milk, straight from the farm. Also selling pasture raised eggs and real dairy ice-cream!

producers.name: Mulroy Meadow Farm
producers.description: Regenerative Agriculture Donegal. Family farm. BSc Environmental Science, Level 6 in Ag, MSc Biological Agriculture, Pharmacist. Hope for the future of Agriculture via real science. Against the grain to regenerate soil and land.

producers.name: Donegal Sea Salt
producers.description: Gravel-filtered, Grade A sea water is pumped from our private sea water well and dried using wind and solar evaporation in polytunnels. The salt crystals left behind are harvested by hand, given a final drying in an oven and packed ready for market. Our salt is produced entirely naturally, without any boiling step, and has no additives, bleaches or anti-caking chemicals added.

producers.name: The Merry Mill
producers.description: The Merry Mill grows and mills organic oats certified gluten free and traceable to a single farm.

producers.name: Rowanhill Farm
producers.description: Rowanhill Farm produces milk, seasonal vegetables, honey and bread from their farm in Cork and sells it all directly from the farm.

producers.name: Staffords Butchers
producers.description: We hand rear our own Angus cattle in the foothills of the Black Stairs Mountains at Kilanne. Every animal is reared on our own ground and we butcher and sell the beef ourselves, so there is nobody standing between our fields and your table.

producers.name: Leitrim Hill Creamery
producers.description: Leitrim Hill Creamery produces handmade goats cheese from their own herd on the drumlin hills of Co. Leitrim, selling direct to local customers.

producers.name: Galtee Honey Farm
producers.description: Galtee Honey Farm is one of Ireland's oldest family-run honey farms nestled in the heart of the Galtee Vee Valley, dedicated to producing award-winning Irish honey.  It is at the heart of Ireland's first Conservation Area for the Native Irish Honey Bee. Calls are appointment only.

producers.name: Ballyconnery Bó
producers.description: The Kiely family farm near Dungarvan, selling fresh pasteurised, non-homogenised milk from their own cows. A self-serve farm shop, with glass bottles available to buy.

producers.name: Coole Farm
producers.description: A market garden in Coole, Ardee, growing salad leaves and vegetables without artificial fertilisers or pesticides. Sold fresh through local shops across the Boyne Valley.

producers.name: Glencar Farm
producers.description: Native-breed Dexter cattle and lamb, raised on grass in the Glencar valley, Co. Leitrim.

producers.name: Riversfield Organic Farm
producers.description: A family-run organic farm in Callan, growing salad greens and vegetables outdoors and under polytunnels with a gentle, low-intervention approach.

producers.name: Muckross Creamery
producers.description: A family dairy farm in Muckross, Killarney, making ice cream and Icelandic-style skyr from their own cows' milk. Pasteurised and churned on site, from cow to cone, and sold from their farm creamery and café.

producers.name: Broadfield Farm
producers.description: A  farm in Ferns, Co. Wexford, selling pasture raised eggs and chicken, using regenerative farming practices.

producers.name: Tracey's Farmhouse Kitchen
producers.description: A small farm on the shores of Strangford Lough in Co. Down, making traditional soda bread, potato bread and wheaten bread on a griddle. No weighing, no measuring, just the way it was always done. Tracey runs baking classes from the farmhouse kitchen.

producers.name: Little Honey House
producers.description: Raw honey producer in County Wexford. Their honey is harvested straight from the hive and sold within the local area.

producers.name: Ballincarey Farm
producers.description: Ten acres of Mediterranean inspired organic vegetables grown in Athy, South Kildare. Sold direct to independent retailers, restaurants and at farmers markets.

producers.name: St Tola
producers.description: Goats cheese and milk produced on their own farm near Ennistymon, Co. Clare, using milk from their own herd. Run by Siobhán, the farm is open to visitors and their cheeses have won at the World Cheese Awards.

producers.name: Buzzing Meadows Farm
producers.description: A small farm producing seasonal cut flowers, local honey and hand-poured beeswax candles. The flowers are grown to organic principles using no-dig methods that build healthy soil and support pollinators, and the honey comes from native Irish bees. Everything is made in small batches.

producers.name: Kilmullen Farm
producers.description: A three-generation family farm in Newcastle, Co. Wicklow, where the Bourkes raise grass-fed lamb alongside 100% Wicklow apple juice and seasonal sweetcorn. The sheep graze on clover, grass and hedgerow herbs, and everything is sold direct from the farm gate and at markets.

producers.name: Happy Roots
producers.description: Practicing sustainable regenerative agriculture. We grow seasonal nutrient dense food that's full of flavour in a way that benefits the local flora and fauna. Focusing on soil health because Happy roots = Happy fruits

producers.name: Valleyview Farm
producers.description: A family farm in Riverstick, Co. Cork, run by Jason and Helga Bryan. They grow potatoes and seasonal vegetables and keep 500 free-range hens in mobile housing that keeps them on fresh pasture, selling eggs, potatoes and vegetables direct from the farm.

producers.name: The Curious Farmer
producers.description: A generational family farm in Tyrone raising Shorthorn cattle in the grass hills of Tyghan

producers.name: Ballyholey Farm
producers.description: A family farm outside Raphoe in Co. Donegal, growing vegetables and potatoes for over 30 years. Ballyholey sells more than 120 varieties direct from their Log Cabin farm shop and at the Letterkenny farmers market.

producers.name: Bare Acre Farm
producers.description: A regenerative vegetable farm in North Co. Dublin, run by Dave and Ber Kavanagh. Bare Acre sells weekly produce boxes along with free-range eggs, bread and seasonal flowers direct from their farm shop.

producers.name: Toons Bridge Dairy
producers.description: Buffalo Milk & Cheese produced from their own herd of water buffalo. Sold directly through their stores and local markets

producers.name: Old Head Milk
producers.description: Small family dairy farm on the old head peninsula where we produce milk to the highest quality and sell it through a self service vending machine.

producers.name: The Lost Valley Dairy
producers.description: A farmhouse cheese operation run by Mike Parle and Darcie Mayland in Inchigeelagh, West Cork. They milk their own mixed herd of Irish Shorthorn and Droimeann cattle, both native heritage breeds. They produce raw milk cheeses including Carraignamuc and Sobhriste. No freeze-dried cultures are used.

producers.name: Pheasants Hill Farm
producers.product: Irish Moiled Beef & Rare Breed Meat
producers.description: A rare breed farm on the shores of Strangford Lough at Killyleagh Road, Downpatrick, rearing Irish Moiled cattle alongside grass fed beef, free range pork and chicken. The Irish Moiled is an ancient Ulster breed that was once the common house cow of small farmers here. Orders are collected at the farm on Friday and Saturday afternoons.

producers.name: Kehoe's Happy Hens
producers.description: Our hens roam freely on our pastures, laying deliciously rich free range eggs.  We gather and pack our own eggs daily. Guaranteeing the freshest of eggs

producers.name: Brave Herders
producers.description: A collective of independent family farms brought together by a love of native Irish livestock breeds. Founded by the O'Riordan family in Millstreet. Jerry farms a herd of Dexter cattle on the foothills of Curragh Mountain. The cattle are grass-fed and free-range, grazing from April to November.

producers.name: Portnoo Market Garden
producers.description: A market garden in rural Donegal growing chemical free vegetables and salad using regenerative and organic methods. They sell direct online and through local shops around the county, and open the garden for farm visits and farm to fork events through the season.

producers.name: Síle Farm and Nursery
producers.product: Pasture raised Eggs, Pork, Raw Honey, Peat-free plants
producers.description: We run a little smallholding, producing pasture raised eggs, pork, honey and a range of native and non-native, peat-free plants. Products are available to order via the website and collection available during onsite shop opening hours on Fridays and Sundays or by appointment.

producers.name: Glasraí Organic Farm
producers.description: We are a small 7 acre farm using soil health and biodiversity principles to grow a sustainable and profitable farm.

producers.name: Butler's Organic Eggs
producers.description: Family-run organic egg farm established in 2007 when David Butler took over the family farm. Hens are free-range on organic Carlow pasture, reared without pesticides, chemicals or antibiotics.

producers.name: Nowen Rock
producers.product: Raw goat milk, beef, chicken, lamb, honey , jam, hen & duck eggs and vegetables
producers.description: Nowen rock is a family run farm with a big vision on community. All our produce is chemical free and produced as close to nature as possible. We have a wide range of produce including goat milk, vegetables, meat of chicken beef and lamb, honey , jam and hen and duck eggs

producers.name: Honey Harvest
producers.description: We are a family run beekeeping business based in Ballymahon, Co.Westmeath, Ireland. As passionate beekeepers, we care deeply about our bees and are dedicated to supporting their wellbeing while producing quality, natural honey.

producers.name: Rathphelan Farm
producers.description: We are a family-run beef farm based in Castletown, Co. Laois, producing quality Irish beef and selling Beef Boxes directly to the public. With the exception of nuts used for vitamins, we grow all the feed for our cattle ourselves, giving us full control over what they eat. Our cattle are grass-fed during the summer and, throughout the winter, are fed a mix of our own Grass Silage, Whole crop Peas & Barley, Kale and home-rolled Barley.

producers.name: McNally Family Farm
producers.description: Family-run organic farm spanning 99 acres in North County Dublin. Patrick and Jenny McNally converted to organic farming in 1997 and have been certified organic since 1998. They grow seasonal vegetables, herbs, salads, roots and fruits across around 50 polytunnels and open fields.

producers.name: Oranmore Organic Farm
producers.description: Small organic family farm on the shores of Galway Bay. Every crop is grown without chemical sprays or artificial fertilisers. They supply boxes of mixed produce, bulk orders for restaurants and direct sales through local markets.
